what: Around the character illustration, a self-talk line is written one character at a time, .05s apart, on a circle (starting at −70°). Each character pops up from 10px below over .3s with cubic-bezier(.55,0,.27,1.55). Every 3 seconds (longer if character count × .05 + 1 second is more) it moves on to the next line, and the face illustration also pops out from .5 scale over .8s with the same curve to change. Clicking moves to the next line right away and restarts the clock. The ‹wait› type rests 1.5s before it starts rotating

options.play: auto (runs right away)·wait (starts from the next phrase after 1.5s)·click (only on press), default auto
options.start: Angle (deg) at which text starts on the circle, default −70
options.inset: From the circle edge to the text line (viewBox 100 basis), default 4
options.--fx-size: Text size (viewBox 100 basis, via style), default 5.2px — font is --kf-font-hand, falling back to --kf-font-display
options.[data-fx-part=caption]: One aside each (required, hidden on screen)
options.[data-fx-part=face]: Face image that changes with each line (optional) — cycles if there are fewer than lines

use: Your musings hereSecond word
